items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Bardu had been with Chick Webb? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, he did. [INTERVIEWER] So did you guys play any of Chick Webb’s music in the band? [INTERVIEWEE] [cannot recall.]

ctx.x: I think I did some writing in high school, but not for a band like that. I was writing for bands – 12, 13, 14, 15 pieces, something like that. That was the start of my writing career.
That was the beginning of that. Bardu had been with Chick Webb?
